title: NameGraph
description: Serialised notlob name-graph produced by NameGraph.to_dict().

nodes.description: All named nodes in the graph.

edges.description: All directed edges in the graph.

Node.description: A named node: module, subheading, appendix, symbol, property, example, run, test, or external.

label.description: Human-readable name as written in source.

kind.description: What type of named thing this node represents.

content.description: Source payload; present only when include_content=True.

start_line.description: 1-based source line number where this node begins in its .lob file.

Content.description: Source content attached to a node.

prose.description: Plain text of prose blocks (refs re-serialised with sigil).

code.description: Dedented source code for the node.

bullet_block_count.description: Number of bullet lists (`* item` blocks) directly in the section. Present only when it is at least 1; the bullet items' text is part of `prose`.

sigil.description: On a claim node: the sigil as written, e.g. `~example`, `~property name`, `~run on-load`. A claim's lines are in `code`.

body.description: On a module, subheading or appendix node: the items of its body, in document order. Subheadings are not body items; they are nodes, reached through CONTAINS.

imports.description: On a module node: its `#References` lines, in order.

BodyItem.description: One item of a node's body: a prose block, a code block, a bullet list, or a claim (by the address of its own node).

text.description: The paragraph, with inline cross-references written with their `#` or `##` sigil.

start_line.description: 1-based source line of the first line, or null if unknown.

items.description: The text of each bullet, without its marker.

address.description: The address of the claim's own node, which holds its sigil and lines.

start_line.description: 1-based source line of the claim's sigil.

sub.description: True for a `##Label` reference (a subheading of this module), false for `#Label`.

lob_ref.description: True for a reference to another lob module (`#Title`), false for a language import, passed through verbatim.

Edge.description: A directed relationship between two nodes.

start_line.description: 1-based .lob file line of the first call site. Present on USES edges only.
